title: Kick's 'Sunset Reward Case' (announced 12 Nov 2026) gives away 10,000 digital codes for GTA VI Ultimate Edition (PS5 or Xbox Series X|S): watch any Kick stream for 3 hours to unlock a daily case; no purchase, payment or wager; odds not stated; codes not issued before 19 Nov (launch); PS5 codes only for PSN accounts in Kick's supported list, which includes India; Xbox codes worldwide; run by Kick, not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two; no end date on Kick's page. Ultimate Edition is Rs 7,499 on PlayStation India. Twitch (13 Nov, TwitchCon) promises surprise daily GTA VI code drops from launch to the end of November, number and regions undisclosed.
